```{r}
#//Al Shifa is in Gaza City
#//EGH:  Khan Younis City
#//Al Nasser is also in Gaza City 

library(ggplot2)

# -----------------------------
# Shared setup
# -----------------------------
months <- c(
  "Oct '23","Nov '23","Dec '23","Jan '24","Feb '24","Mar '24",
  "Apr '24","May '24","Jun '24","Jul '24","Aug '24","Sep '24",
  "Oct '24","Nov '24","Dec '24","Jan '25","Feb '25","Mar '25",
  "Apr '25","May '25"
)

level_map <- c("Low" = 1, "Medium" = 2, "High" = 3)

# Muted/pastel-ish but still clear
color_map <- c(
  "Low"    = "#78B88B",  # muted green
  "Medium" = "#E0C04C",  # muted yellow
  "High"   = "#D06A5C"   # muted red
)

make_timeline_plot <- function(location_name, values, out_file) {
  if (length(values) != length(months)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Error: '%s' has %d values but months has %d entries.",
      location_name, length(values), length(months)
    ))
  }

  df <- data.frame(
    month  = factor(months, levels = months),
    level  = factor(values, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
    height = unname(level_map[values])
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = month, y = height, fill = level)) +
    geom_col(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      width = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"),
      limits = c(0, 3.2),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(location_name, ": Population Density Timeline\nOctober 2023 to May 2025"),
      x = "Month",
      y = "Population Density Level"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      # All fonts black
      text = element_text(color = "black", family = "sans"),

      # Titles / axes
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.2),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),

      # Make axes & ticks black (no gray)
      axis.line  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),

      # White backgrounds, no rounded corners
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),

      # Legend styling
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = out_file,
    plot     = p,
    width    = 10,
    height   = 5,
    dpi      = 300,
    bg       = "white"
  )

  message("Saved: ", out_file)
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Gaza City values (from your example)
# NOTE: your pasted values list appears to have 20 entries; months has 20.
# -----------------------------
gaza_city_values <- c(
  "Medium","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low",
  "Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Medium","Medium",
  "Medium","Medium","Medium","Medium"
)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Khan Younis values (REPLACE with your 20 monthly entries)
# -----------------------------
khan_younis_values <- c(
  "Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low",
  "Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low","Low",
  "Low","Low","Low","Low"
)

# -----------------------------
# Export two separate images
# -----------------------------
make_timeline_plot("Gaza City",  gaza_city_values,  "gaza_city_population_density.png")
make_timeline_plot("Khan Younis", khan_younis_values, "khan_younis_population_density.png")
```
